risk.caveat.pce_not_asian: PCE was not derived in Asian populations and may overestimate risk; Thai CV Risk is the headline estimate.
risk.not_valid.pce_range: Not valid: inputs are outside the PCE validated ranges (age 40–79, total cholesterol 130–320, HDL 20–100, systolic BP 90–200).
risk.not_valid.thai_range: Not valid: inputs are outside the Thai CV Risk validated ranges (age 30–70, systolic BP 70–220).
risk.suggestion.pce.low: Emphasise lifestyle change; reassess risk factors every 4–6 years.
risk.suggestion.pce.borderline: Discuss risk. If risk enhancers are present, a moderate-intensity statin may be considered after shared decision-making.
risk.suggestion.pce.intermediate: A moderate-intensity statin is reasonable; risk enhancers favour starting. Reinforce lifestyle change.
risk.suggestion.pce.high: Consider a high-intensity statin to lower LDL-C by at least 50%; reassess lipids 4–12 weeks after starting.
risk.suggestion.thai.low: Emphasise lifestyle change and reassess risk factors periodically.
risk.suggestion.thai.moderate: Intensive lifestyle change; discuss statin if risk factors remain uncontrolled or risk enhancers are present.
risk.suggestion.thai.high: Lifestyle change and consider statin therapy; control blood pressure and glucose.
risk.suggestion.thai.very_high: Consider high-intensity statin therapy; control blood pressure and glucose; arrange close follow-up.
risk.htn_stage1.lt10: Stage 1 hypertension (130–139 / 80–89 mmHg) with 10-year risk below 10%: lifestyle modification and recheck.
risk.htn_stage1.ge10: Stage 1 hypertension (130–139 / 80–89 mmHg) with 10-year risk 10% and above: consider blood-pressure medication plus lifestyle modification.
risk.bypass.ascvd: Known atherosclerotic CVD - secondary prevention: risk calculators do not apply.
risk.bypass.ldl190: LDL cholesterol 190 mg/dL or higher: high-intensity statin is indicated regardless of calculated risk.
risk.enhancer.retinal_arteriolar_narrowi: Risk enhancer: retinal arteriolar narrowing (artery-to-vein ratio outside reference)
risk.enhancer_note.borderline: In the 5–7.5% band, risk enhancers favour a statin discussion. Enhancers do not change the calculated risk.
risk.arcus.observation: Arcus senilis recorded as a clinical observation; it is not an input to the risk equations.
risk.arcus.young: Arcus senilis under age 45 - check lipid profile; consider familial hypercholesterolaemia. It is not an input to the risk equations.
limit.emergency.trained_established: The model was trained on established (not hyperacute) retinal artery occlusions.
limit.emergency.early_normal: An early CRAO can look normal on a fundus photo.
limit.heatmap_attention: The heatmap shows model attention, not confirmed lesions.
limit.screening.not_diagnostic: Retinal measurements are risk enhancers for discussion; they do not diagnose disease or change the calculated risk.
explain.emergency.likely: The model rates a retinal artery occlusion as likely (probability {p}, quality {q}). Please confirm on the image.
explain.emergency.uncertain: The model is uncertain (probability {p}, quality {q}). Specialist review is recommended; this is neither a positive nor a negative finding.
explain.emergency.unlikely: The model rates a retinal artery occlusion as unlikely (probability {p}, quality {q}); this does not rule it out.
summary.emergency.STROKE_PATHWAY: Your eye findings may be a stroke of the eye. You are being referred to the stroke team right away.
summary.emergency.URGENT: Your eye findings need a same-day check for stroke and heart causes.
summary.emergency.ESCALATE: A specialist eye doctor needs to look at your images urgently.
summary.emergency.RETAKE: The photo was not clear enough. It will be retaken, or you will be referred without delay.
summary.emergency.ROUTINE: Your photo does not suggest an emergency. Please see an eye doctor routinely for your vision complaint.
summary.screening.pce.low: Your 10-year risk of heart disease and stroke is low. Keep up healthy habits.
summary.screening.pce.borderline: Your 10-year risk is borderline. Talk with your doctor about lifestyle and whether other factors matter.
summary.screening.pce.intermediate: Your 10-year risk is intermediate. Talk with your doctor about lifestyle and possible treatment.
summary.screening.pce.high: Your 10-year risk is high. Talk with your doctor about treatment and follow-up.
risk.not_valid.sex: Not valid: sex must be recorded as male or female.
risk.htn_stage1: Stage 1 hypertension (130–139 / 80–89 mmHg): lifestyle modification and recheck; 10-year risk could not be calculated for this age.
explain.emergency.region.macula: The model focused on the macula. CRAO typically whitens the macula and can produce a cherry-red spot at the fovea; please confirm on the image.
explain.emergency.region.optic_disc: The model focused on the optic disc. Please confirm on the image whether the disc looks swollen or pale.
explain.emergency.region.arcades: The model focused on the vascular arcades. Please confirm on the image whether the arteries look narrowed or the retina is pale along them.
explain.emergency.region.periphery: The model focused on the peripheral retina, away from the usual sites of CRAO findings. Please review the whole image.
explain.emergency.region.unavailable: The optic disc could not be located, so no region-based explanation is given.
summary.screening.thai.low: Your 10-year risk of heart disease and stroke is low. Keep up healthy habits.
summary.screening.thai.moderate: Your 10-year risk is moderate. Talk with your doctor about lifestyle changes and whether treatment is needed.
summary.screening.thai.high: Your 10-year risk is high. Talk with your doctor about treatment and follow-up.
summary.screening.thai.very_high: Your 10-year risk is very high. Please discuss treatment and close follow-up with your doctor soon.
